    { type: 'mrkdwn', text: `*Company*

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  "Timestamp": j.scored_at,
  "Name": j.name,
  "Company": j.company,
  "Email": j.email,
  "Phone": j.caller_number,
  "Need": j.need,
  "Details": j.need_details,
  "Budget": j.budget_label,
  "Timeline": j.timeline_label,
  "Decision Maker": j.decision_maker ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  "Score": j.score,
  "Tier": j.tier,
  "Booked": j.booking_confirmed ? j.booked_slot : 'No',
  "Summary": j.summary,
  "Next Action": j.next_action,
  "Call Type": j.call_type,
  "Duration (s)": j.duration_sec,
  "Cost ($)": j.cost_usd,
  "Recording": j.recording_url,
  "Call ID": j.call_id,
} }];
